newsitem.title: JAPAN: Jidosha Kiki to form joint Thai venture.
newsitem.headline: Jidosha Kiki to form joint Thai venture.

text.p: Jidosha Kiki Co Ltd (JKC), a Japanese car component maker, said on Wednesday that it had agreed to form a joint venture on November 25 in Thailand to produce brake system components.
The new company, BJKC (Thailand) Co Ltd will be owned 41 percent by JKC, 39 percent by Robert Bosch GmbH and 20 percent by Zexel Sales Thailand Co Ltd, a Thai sales unit of Zexel Corp.
The joint venture will invest more than one billion yen to build a new plant in Amata, Rayong province, to start production there in December 1997.
The company will create 140 jobs by the year 2000.
The products will be sold to carmakers in Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) member states, including Japanese makers' units in Thailand.
The company hopes to achieve annual sales of about 500 million baht by the year 2000.
Zexel owns 31.1 percent of JKC, while Robert Bosch owns 13.4 percent of Zexel.
